name: kalshidash1-dev-tools
description: Dev-only test tooling for KalshiDash1. The published site itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies. No "type" field on purpose: existing checkers in scripts/ are CommonJS (.js) while the engine and tests are ESM (.mjs), and adding type=module broke them.

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:feed && npm run test:feed-current && npm run test:rescore && npm run test:guard && npm run test:resolution && npm run test:page && npm run test:ids && npm run test:rows && npm run test:stale && npm run test:lab && npm run test:cors && npm run test:links && npm run test:paper && npm run test:chart && npm run test:settlement && npm run test:demo-safety && npm run test:writers
